title: Bugkind poster sequence

location.series: Pentagram / Natural History Museum case study

slide_intent: Connect an unfamiliar subject with a familiar phrase, because wordplay can give viewers a way into scientific content.
strategic_value: The altered giant-leap phrase can make insects approachable while the repeated ring composition preserves Museum recognition.
demonstration: Two insect posters with pink ring fields flank a dark text poster reading One small step for man / one giant leap for bugkind.
practical_value: Compare an image-led pair with a text-led center to create a campaign sequence.

content_islands.name: Insect pair
content_islands.spec: Place large beetle images over circular NHM letter fields on the left and right pink posters.

content_islands.name: Central statement
content_islands.spec: Set the wordplay in large pale type on the dark middle poster with the museum signature below.

content_islands.name: Display context
content_islands.spec: Align all three frames on one wall.
